sentences.en: I see many trees in the garden.
sentences.zh: 我在花园里看到很多树。

sentences.en: The birds fly in the sky.
The river is long and wide.
I watch the leaves fall from the tree.
sentences.zh: 我看着树叶从树上掉下来。

sentences.en: The mountain is high and far away.
The sun goes down in the evening.
I like to look at the stars at night.
The grass is green after the rain.
